```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(purrr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
cust_df <- readr::read_csv("data/laser_league_players.csv")
num_cols <- cust_df %>%
  dplyr::select(age, volunteer_hours, energy_reduction_pct, wellbeing_index, monthly_water_usage_l)
cust_scaled <- scale(num_cols)
```

```{r}
wss_values <- map_dbl(2:6, ~kmeans(cust_scaled, centers = .x, nstart = 10)$tot.withinss)
wss_values
```

```{r}
kmeans_model <- kmeans(cust_scaled, centers = 3, nstart = 20)
summary(kmeans_model)
```

```{r}
cust_clustered <- cust_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cluster = factor(kmeans_model$cluster))
head(cust_clustered)
```
